name: DevStrefa Text to Speech for ElevenLabs
author: devstrefa

sections.description:
DevStrefa Text to Speech for ElevenLabs lets you generate spoken audio for WordPress posts and pages with the ElevenLabs API and show a player on the front end.

This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by ElevenLabs. ElevenLabs is a trademark of its respective owner.

Features

  • Generate MP3 audio from post or page content using your ElevenLabs API key
  • Choose which public post types get audio, including custom types registered by other plugins
  • Generate audio from the posts list, including several selected items at once
  • Generate posts longer than 10,000 characters
  • Choose the ElevenLabs model, pronunciation language, stability, similarity, style, speed, and speaker boost
  • Browse the voices on an account, filter them, and preview a short sample
  • Connect up to 3 ElevenLabs accounts. Each account has its own voice, speech settings, and usage statistics
  • Play your own audio file on a post or page instead of the generated MP3
  • Set the player header text for one post or page
  • Player themes: Default, Compact, and Modern
  • Live appearance preview in settings
  • Reads content from the WordPress editor (classic / Gutenberg) and Elementor
  • BeBuilder (BeTheme) layouts are detected and are not read
  • Shortcode [dseltts_audio] for manual placement
  • Character estimate in the post editor before audio is generated
  • AudioObject structured data for posts and pages that have audio

Premium add-on

A separate Premium add-on (not included in this plugin) can add extra player themes and generation options. Details: https://devstrefa.pl/en/plugins/elevenlabs-wordpress/

External services

This plugin connects to the ElevenLabs text-to-speech API so it can turn post or page text into an MP3 audio file. It is required for generating speech. You must create your own ElevenLabs account and enter your own API key in the plugin settings. The plugin does not create an ElevenLabs account for you and does not use a shared key.

Data is sent only when an administrator or editor generates audio (from the post editor or from plugin settings when fetching voices or usage statistics). The following data may be sent to ElevenLabs:

  • The prepared article text (and optionally the post title) when generating speech
  • Your ElevenLabs API key in the xi-api-key request header. Up to 3 accounts can be connected, and each request uses the key of the account that generates the audio or whose statistics are being loaded
  • Voice ID and voice settings (stability, similarity, style, speed, and speaker boost) when generating speech
  • The selected model and, for models that accept it, the pronunciation language
  • No visitor browsing data is sent while someone only plays an already generated file on the site

Generated MP3 files are stored in your WordPress Media Library (uploads folder). Playback on the site uses that local file and does not call the ElevenLabs API again.

This service is provided by ElevenLabs:

  • Terms of Use (non-EEA): https://elevenlabs.io/terms-of-use
  • Terms of Use (EEA/EU): https://elevenlabs.io/terms-of-use-eu
  • Privacy Policy: https://elevenlabs.io/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open DevStrefa TTS in the admin menu.
  4. Enter your ElevenLabs API key and connect.
  5. Open Voices, choose a voice, and save the speech settings.
  6. Open a post or page and generate audio. You can also generate it from the list.
sections.faq:
Do I need an ElevenLabs account?

Yes. The plugin uses the official ElevenLabs HTTP API with the key you enter in settings.

What data is sent to ElevenLabs?

When you generate audio, the plugin sends the selected post or page text and your API key to api.elevenlabs.io. Fetching the voice list or usage statistics also uses your API key. See the External services section above.

Which content is read?

The WordPress editor (including Gutenberg blocks) and Elementor canvas content. BeBuilder / BeTheme page layouts are not converted to speech.

Can I use more than one ElevenLabs account?

Yes. Account 1 is the API key on the Connection tab. Click Add account to connect a second and a third account. Each account has its own voice, speech settings, and statistics. On a post or page you choose which account generates the audio.

Which content types can have audio?

Posts and pages are selected by default. On the Settings tab you can also select other public types that WordPress or another plugin has registered.

Can one article be longer than 10,000 characters?

Yes. The text is split into parts of up to 10,000 characters (4,500 for the v3 model) and the parts are joined into one MP3.

Can I generate audio without opening each item?

Yes. The list of each selected content type has an Audio column with the character and credit estimate for the default account, plus Generate or Regenerate. Select several rows and use Generate audio for selected.

Can I use my own audio file?

Yes. In the post or page editor, use Add audio file. The player on the site uses that file instead of the generated MP3. Remove the file to use the generated audio again.

Can I place the player myself?

Yes. Set display location to manual and use [dseltts_audio] or [dseltts_audio id="123"].
sections.changelog:
2.0.1

  • The header logo is stored in the plugin files instead of being loaded from the site media library.

2.0.0

  • New admin panel with the DevStrefa header, tabs, and a status sidebar.
  • New Voices screen: account, model, pronunciation language, stability, similarity, style, speed, speaker boost, and a filterable voice list. A preview plays only after you click Play preview.
  • Settings can choose which public content types get audio, including custom types.
  • Lists of those types show an Audio column with the default-account estimate and Generate or Regenerate. Selected rows can be generated together.
  • Text longer than one request is generated in parts and saved as one MP3. Flash and Turbo use half a credit per character.
  • The connection screen is for accounts only. Voices and speech settings are on the Voices tab.

1.2.0

  • Connect up to 3 ElevenLabs accounts. Extra accounts are added with a button, and each one has its own voice, stability, similarity, and statistics.
  • A post or page can use its own audio file and its own player header text.
  • When more than one account is connected, choose which account generates the audio.
  • The manual shortcode player keeps its layout, and its styles load on the page that contains the shortcode.
  • The player controls wrap onto the next line when there is not enough width.

1.1.0

  • Compact theme keeps the single control row. Modern theme uses a separate rounded bar.
  • The post editor shows how many characters will be sent before audio is generated.
  • Posts and pages with audio include AudioObject structured data.
  • After 5 generated audio files, the editor can ask for a rating once. The prompt can be closed.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
